maya: Idea 10-min hands-on lab + micro-benchmark: give 150 starter tokens + 3 plug-and-play prompts. Goal: boost first-api-request -> activation within 24h by ~12%.

jordan: Short and sharp. Primary metric = activated within 24h. Secondary = prompt adoption rate, median latency for starter prompts, 48h re-engage.

samir: Routing Q 1 A/B SDR vs auto-onboard? We should test both.

olivia: Agree. Variant A: SDR handoff for high-intent (company_size>50 or allowlist). Variant B: instant self-serve + email guide.

bex (growth-eng): I can implement routing flags. Draft rule:
```
{
  "segment":"lab_signup",
  "rules":[{"if":"company_size>50","route":"sdr"},{"else":"auto_onboard"}]
}
```
I'll add events: lab_signup, tokens_granted, prompt_invoked.

maya: For auto flow: immediate 150 tokens, in-app prompt pack, inline nudge at first API call, 12h follow-up with 3 suggested uses.

jordan: Landing microcopy: "Hands-on lab: 150 free tokens + 3 ready-to-run prompts 6 a quick benchmark" Keep it short.

olivia: Also add a 48h micro-survey: two quick MCQs + 1 free-text for blockers. Helps capture quality/regression issues.

zara-bot: Calendar created: Hands-on Lab 1 Thu 11:00. :calendar: 

bex (growth-eng): Timeline: slides + one-pager by Tue EOD, landing + routing Wed AM, run Thu. I'll drop the landing draft in #marketing-drafts shortly.

maya: Perfect. We'll watch the hourly dashboard during the first 24h and reconvene post-mortem next week.

everyone: +1
